description: An Anishinabek StoryMap identifies abandoned mines by region and site status, and a related 2023 dashboard describes mine-site classes A–D, closure-plan and rehabilitation-plan indicators, and jurisdiction. The dashboard credits Ontario AMIS source data downloaded in 2023. Both items are information interfaces about abandoned mining infrastructure. They are grouped as related regional mine-status sources, without claiming identical inventories or matching each feature across interfaces. The metadata does not define the class categories, provide a current site count or establish actual completion of rehabilitation. Native item terms limit use to information sharing. No dashboard data, feature records or StoryMap body was fetched. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Anishinabek Nation Lands and Resources Department; source-specific creators retained. Licence: Native ArcGIS source-specific terms: information-sharing or educational/analytical use where stated; standard licence unstated. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says public; isopen is false. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities.
